content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi tubulodawek yoŋa Bepaŋ ninadiguk
Bepaŋ, du yonadine u nadi hinek tibeŋ! Katibulabulaye tibene sigilulum mu tinambeŋ.
Nadibedinedi nehitubu-kadaka tibene tilak, doktiŋa du yonadine momooŋgoŋ nadiŋa medene tubu-udaneweŋ.

Memik heki adi nehitubu-kadaka titiŋdok mede fafaŋeŋgoŋ toiŋ. Me kadakahi wendi nehitifofoŋ tiiŋ doktiŋa welemulap kisaŋ hinek nadilat. Adi malabumuŋ gibitaŋ namiiŋ, tiŋa kwihikwihileŋgoŋ tiŋila memik kisaŋgoŋ hinek tinamiiŋ.
Kaŋ nu aditok munta kisaŋ hinek tiyemiŋa, kumuŋ tibitneŋ yoŋa hehele tilat. Kaŋ wendi welene tubumalabuda hinek tilak.
Unduŋ tiŋa munta kisaŋ tibene foloone heheledapmaŋ tilak. Kaŋ muntadi nehitifohinaka tilak.
Kaŋ nu indiŋ yolat, “Nu adi butigili hekidi papalihinit hatiiŋ, deti undugoŋ tilit yoŋa nadilat. Unduŋ tiŋa woleeŋ wooŋ kwet niŋ tubumintaaŋ uŋgoŋ ila hali hakule titiŋdok nadilat.
Nu adi kweetniŋ hinek woleeŋ wooŋ kwet fiileŋ uŋgoŋ hatibaat.
Nu pilap hinek woleeŋ wooŋ hebihatdok kwet neeŋ tubumintait, tiŋa fifiŋgobut dut gwi muŋkulap’walaŋ naihik foloŋ kedem kabup hebihatibaat.”
Meeniŋ yokwet wapum maaneŋ mik kaka tiyaune yabulat. Unduŋ doktiŋa, Wapum, du medehik kedem tubugiyondaaŋ yehitubu-liwedapmaŋ tibeŋ.
Hadapmo be timiŋ adi looŋ yokwet wapum wendiniŋ gimbahaŋ foloniŋ hati yawiiŋ. Eŋ yokwet wapumneŋ uŋoŋ metamdi yom eŋ malabumuŋ fee tiiŋ.

Yokwet wapum maaneŋ uŋoŋ me nolidi pilali metam yehitubu-kadakaaŋ nemenemek noli maaŋ yehitubu-kadakatawiiŋ. Tiŋa talik gagayeŋ be bopkwetneŋ meeniŋ noli yeniyehimoŋgofoiŋ, unduŋ tiŋa nemenemekhik kuboneyemdok tikamanda maaŋ tiyemiiŋ.
Memik niŋdi binek nanimpekit tibetik uyadi welemulap nadiŋila fiit hatibetit. Eŋ memik niŋdi naniŋfoko tiŋa gigine tubune kaŋ woŋ adi momoŋ tiŋa wooŋ niŋkade hebihatiluwaat.
Iŋgoŋ yoŋ adi me notne momooŋ, tiŋa me notne na’walaŋ hinehinekdigoŋ kudi i tilak.
Koom adi noŋgoŋ yauŋa mede yonadi wanakaŋ momooŋ hinek tagumut, tiŋa undugoŋ metam noli dut Bepaŋ yolineŋ noŋgoŋ wagumun.

Memikneye adi titiŋ kadakahidi welehik gineŋ eŋ yohik maaneŋ kilidapmaŋ tilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi yadi pilap kumuneŋdok nadilat. Kaipmuŋ hatiiŋneŋ nai indidegoŋ yeniŋkulune me kumuhi’walaŋ yohikwehineŋ fogidibaneŋ.
Iŋgoŋ nu adi Yahwedi nehitubu-lodawek yoŋa ninadilat, doktiŋa negoŋ nehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ nanagilek.
Nu malabumuŋnedok koyone haniŋ-timiŋ, mele lekiŋgoŋ eŋ bufali tibene Bepaŋ’walaŋkade ulak. Kaŋ adi yonadine u nadilak.
Mik wapum gineŋ wene memik feedi mik tinamiiŋ, iŋgoŋ Bepaŋdi nabudokooŋ kotigoŋ nanagila bulak.

Koomkwaha Bepaŋ adi Mapme hatiguk, eŋ kobuk maaŋ adigoŋ Mapme hatilak. Wendoktiŋa negoŋ yonadine nadinamuŋa memik heki mik gineŋ fafaŋe tiŋa widihidapmaŋ tibaak. Adi Bepaŋ gikiŋgoŋ mu timiiŋ doktiŋa nemek niŋdi nemu yaheheweyemiŋa yehitubu-lodawaak.
Me notne adi koom me noliŋiye dut mede yofolok tigiŋ u bikabuŋa noliŋiye mik tiyemulak.
Maŋiŋ foloŋ adi mede kobaŋ hinek yolak, iŋgoŋ oŋ, weleŋ gineŋ adi memik tinamulak. Medeŋiŋdi welekulema tubumintalak nabugoŋ, iŋgoŋ mede u yadi miknoŋ maŋiŋnit hinek doktiŋa nihidobu tilak.
Malabumuŋ hogohogok hekilaŋ u Yahwe kohoŋ foloŋ boiweŋ, kaŋ adi hekiŋa saŋiniŋ kedem gambaak. Adi me didimehi biyabune nemek niŋdi tuwot mu yehitubu-kadakawaak.
Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ, du adi me widihikumuŋ tiiŋ eŋ yalaŋ-me heki, adi yadi yehikelekut tubune meyot gineŋ fooŋ liwe tineeŋ. Naihik mu dapmalune kumuneeŋ. Iŋgoŋ nu adi du hogok nadisukilitigambaat.
